purpose: Keep P1C01 production advancing while UE4/Warehouse execution is unavailable by preparing bounded, provenance-preserving source batches that can later be consumed without changing chapter scope.
evidence_boundary: This queue is source/preparation state only. It does not claim STAGED, READY_FOR_IMPORT, IMPORTED, INTEGRATED, COMPILE-TESTED, PIE-TESTED, DEVICE-TESTED, VISUALLY-ACCEPTED or performance evidence.
global_rules: Prefer already-staged warehouse stock when machine execution is reachable.
Do not create redundant self-hosted jobs when the matching UE4 runner is unavailable.
Keep generated/source promotion separate from Unreal proof heads.
Production textures remain PNG/TGA, including channel-packed textures where used.
Heavy runtime assets remain soft-referenced and asynchronously loaded through FStreamableManager.
Ambient crowds remain pooled and bounded.
Provider/license/provenance blockers move to manual queue or quarantine while independent lanes continue.

batches.next_machine_gate: Exact-head UE4 import/build proof on generated source branch.
Receipt-hash verification, bounded extraction, class QC, then explicit READY_FOR_IMPORT promotion.
Audition, trim/fade, loop/loudness/concurrency QC, then UE import.

batches.runtime_rule: Preserve existing fauna caps and pooling; do not raise density during intake.
batches.next_machine_gate: Explicit license capture plus skeleton/skin/deformation/animation QC.
Skeleton/skin/retarget/deformation QC followed by exact-head Unreal proof.

when_self_hosted_runner_returns: Consume already-prepared batches in order with bounded Warehouse/Unreal execution.
Do not merge source-preparation proof as engine proof.
Freeze any exact head awaiting Unreal/Warehouse evidence and continue independent source preparation on a separate branch.
resume_policy.when_provider_blocked: Manual-queue or quarantine the affected item and continue other independent batches.
